info.title: About Lost Clients
info.body:
The system <highlight>automatically detects clients</highlight> who have not had an appointment within a set period, and sends them a personalized re-booking message.

AI <highlight>generates the message content based on your configuration</highlight> — the text is tailored to each client individually, taking into account their history and services. This way your message never sounds like mass mail, but like a personal invitation to return.

With this system you <highlight>win back clients who would otherwise go to a competitor</highlight> — without manual work and without forgotten contacts.

If you have any questions, contact us at help@jedroplus.com.
